entities.summary: Michał Kazimierz Pac was a nobleman and prominent military leader of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, and of one the most influential members of the magnate Pac family. Educated by Jesuits and Mikołaj Krzysztof "the Orphan" Radziwiłł, Pac joined the military at a young age and rose through its ranks to fight against Russian, Turkish, and Swedish armies. Throughout his life, Pac was the field hetman of Lithuania, voivode of Smolensk, as well as the great hetman. Known for being a devout and ambitious personality of the Baroque period, Pac was interred below the Church of St.
